title: Vendors & subcontractors
description: Optional directory of suppliers and subcontractors you work with. Expenses never require a vendor record.

empty.title: No vendors yet
empty.body: Vendors are optional. Keep a simple directory and link suppliers to projects when helpful — or save them from an expense later.

create.title: New vendor
create.description: Only a name is required. Type helps classify the relationship — you can change it anytime.
create.typeHint: Contextual label only — not a rigid classification.

detail.title: Vendor profile
detail.contactsEmpty: No contacts yet. Add one when you need a site or billing contact.
detail.engagementsHint: Projects this vendor is engaged on. Engagement itself is not a cost — Actual comes from bills or expenses.
detail.engagementsEmpty: No active project links yet. Add an engagement when they work on a project.
detail.addEngagementSuccess: Engagement added. No cost Actual was created.
detail.endEngagementDescription: End the engagement on {name}. This does not create or change cost Actual.
detail.cancelEngagementDescription: Cancel the engagement on {name}. This does not create or change cost Actual.
detail.archiveConfirm: Archive this vendor? Existing engagements keep their history; the vendor is hidden from the active directory.
detail.typeClearHint: Type is a clear label (supplier, subcontractor, both, or other) — change it anytime without affecting expenses or bills.

projectPanel.title: Contractors & vendors
projectPanel.description: Optional engagements with dates. Linking a vendor does not create cost — Actual comes from bills or expenses.
projectPanel.empty: No contractors engaged yet. Add an engagement when a vendor works on this project.
projectPanel.addSuccess: Engagement added. No cost Actual was created.
projectPanel.noCandidates: Add a vendor first (Vendors → New vendor), then come back to engage them.
projectPanel.endEngagementDescription: End {name}'s engagement on this project. This does not create or change cost Actual.
projectPanel.cancelEngagementDescription: Cancel {name}'s engagement on this project. This does not create or change cost Actual.

subcontracts.sectionHint: A subcontract is a commitment, not an expense. Current value is original plus approved changes. Paid amounts come from vendor bills — this screen never posts AP.
subcontracts.addSuccess: Subcontract saved as draft. Original value was recorded. No AP bill was posted.
subcontracts.activateDescription: Activate {name}. This does not create an expense or post a vendor bill.
subcontracts.completeDescription: Mark {name} as completed. Current value does not change.
subcontracts.cancelDescription: Cancel {name}. Current value does not change. This does not post AP.
subcontracts.addChangeSuccess: Approved change recorded. Current value updated. Original was not changed.
subcontracts.commitmentNote: Commitment ≠ expense. Current value is not payment.
subcontracts.cashNote: Paid and outstanding come from existing vendor bills for this vendor and project.
subcontracts.noVendors: Add a vendor first, then come back.
subcontracts.noParentContracts: No parent contract on this project.
